content: Two viable patterns for recurring next-occurrence dates without a cron/worker: (1) compute + store 'proxima_data_sugerida' at write time (when a visit is completed), simple date-math (freq interval added to concluded date) done in the completion RPC/Server Action — cheapest, no background job needed, matches serverless constraints; (2) compute on-read from a stored frequency + last-completed-date, via a SQL function/view evaluated each time the Agenda is queried — avoids a stale stored column but recomputes every read. For a low-volume internal CRM (hundreds of clients) with a human-confirms-the-date UX (not silent automation), store-at-write-time is simplest and sufficient; a full RRULE library is overkill.
